regressions: includes/GetConfig.php now selects unrealizedexchangediffact unconditionally. On an existing database that has not been upgraded yet, the first login fails: the company query hits an unknown column and DB_query exits with a database error. Only a later request reaches the Z_UpgradeDatabase redirect. The reference guards against this with SHOW COLUMNS.
BankReconciliation.php exchange-difference postings (also bank revaluation, so unrealized) still go to the sales exchange variance account, so realized and unrealized P/L stay mixed for that path.
A.justification: A adds the column the way webERP does it: an AddColumn upgrade script, the install schema, the demo data and the installer INSERT. It initialises the column from the sales exchange account for existing installations, gives it a GL picker on the preferences page, and adds it to every control-account list (GLAccounts, ChangeGLAccountCode, template file, GetConfig). The shared revaluation function posts to the new account, with a sensible fallback. It misses BankReconciliation.php, which is the second bank revaluation path the task covers. It also makes GetConfig select the new column unconditionally, so on an un-upgraded database the first login fails with a database error before the upgrade redirect. The update script uses a raw DB_query with an ErrMsg instead of the executeSQL helper and has no Updates['Errors'] guard (40.php has none either). That is a small deviation, and it works.

1: sql/updates/41.php uses AddColumn for companies.unrealizedexchangediffact; install/sql/tables/companies.sql, install/sql/demo.sql and includes/InstallFunctions.php are updated. The legacy sql/demo.sql was left alone.
2: 41.php runs executeSQL UPDATE ... SET unrealizedexchangediffact = exchangediffact. SQL_CommonFunctions falls back to exchangediffact when the field is ''/'0' or missing (?? '').
3: CompanyPreferences.php adds a P&L GL account select 'Currency Exchange (Unrealized) P/L GL Account', loads it from the company row and saves it in the UPDATE.
4: includes/SQL_CommonFunctions.php revaluation now uses the new account. BankReconciliation.php still posts to exchangediffact.
5: The customer and supplier allocation scripts are unchanged and stay on exchangediffact / purchasesexchangediffact.
6: GLAccounts.php, Z_ChangeGLAccountCode.php, Z_CreateCompanyTemplateFile.php and includes/GetConfig.php all include the new column.

regressions: includes/GetConfig.php selects the new column unconditionally, so the first login on a not-yet-upgraded database dies with an unknown-column database error before the upgrade redirect. The reference avoids this with SHOW COLUMNS.
BankReconciliation.php bank exchange-difference postings still go to the sales (realized) exchange variance account.
B.justification: B is almost the same change as A. It has a correct AddColumn upgrade that initialises the new account from exchangediffact, the schema, demo and installer updates, a GL picker and save in CompanyPreferences, and full coverage of the control-account lists. The revaluation function uses the new account, with a slightly more defensive fallback (?? '' and the '0' default). Its upgrade script matches webERP idiom a little better than A's (executeSQL plus the Updates['Errors'] guard before UpdateDBNo). On the other hand, it leaves stray indentation in Z_CreateCompanyTemplateFile.php and in the Payment Discount label. Like A, it misses the BankReconciliation.php revaluation posting. It also leaves GetConfig selecting a column that does not exist until the upgrade has run, which breaks the first post-deploy login on existing installations. Realized postings are correctly left alone.
